_comment: Copy of the file that cpd_init.py generates at ~/.config/cpd-onprem/config.json. You normally do NOT edit this by hand — run `python scripts/cpd_init.py`. Every value can also be supplied via an environment variable (CPD_URL, CPD_USERNAME, CPD_API_KEY, CPD_SPACE_ID, CPD_PROJECT_ID, CPD_DEPLOYMENT_ID, CPD_WXO_INSTANCE_URL, CPD_VERIFY_SSL), which takes precedence over this file.
